# Smartly Tools

> Fast, free, and privacy-first online utilities and digital calculators for students, job applicants, creators, and everyday productivity.

Smartly Tools provides a comprehensive suite of 20+ client-side web tools executed directly inside the user's browser, ensuring zero server-side retention of sensitive files, financial figures, or private calculations.

## Everyday Tools

- [QR Code Generator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/qr-generator): Create customized QR codes with logo support for UPI payments, Wi-Fi credentials, and URLs with PNG/SVG export.
- [Password Generator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/password-generator): Generate cryptographically secure passwords and passphrases using Web Crypto API.
- [Unit Converter](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/unit-converter): Convert metric and imperial units across 7 measurement categories, including regional land units (Bigha, Guntha, Gaj, Ground, Marla).
- [Date Difference](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/date-difference): Calculate calendar day spans, working business days, and exact years/months/days between dates.
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/bmi-calculator): Compute Body Mass Index with WHO standard and Asian consensus adjusted health thresholds.
- [Private Calculator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/private-calculator): High-speed chained arithmetic calculator with secret PIN vault verification concept preview.
- [Private Calling](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/private-calling): Interactive concept preview for privacy-first, number-masked outbound communications.

## Document Tools

- [JPG to PDF](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/jpg-to-pdf): In-browser photo to PDF document compiler with direct WhatsApp and social sharing.
- [PDF to JPG](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Extract PDF pages as individual high-resolution JPG images client-side.
- [PDF Compressor](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/pdf-compressor): Compress PDF document file sizes to meet 100 KB, 200 KB, or 500 KB portal limits.
- [Image Compressor](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/image-compressor): Compress photo and signature images to under 20 KB or 50 KB for application forms.
- [Image Resizer](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/image-resizer): Resize and crop images to exact pixel dimensions (passport 350x450, signature 200x230).

## Finance Tools

- [EMI Calculator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/emi-calculator): Calculate loan monthly installments, total interest, and principal amortization schedule.
- [SIP Calculator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/sip-calculator): Project mutual fund wealth accumulation with compounding and annual step-up increments.
- [GST Calculator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/gst-calculator): Calculate inclusive and exclusive tax across standard slabs (5%, 12%, 18%, 28%) with CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown.
- [Salary Calculator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/salary-calculator): Convert annual CTC to monthly take-home salary comparing old vs new tax regimes.
- [FD Calculator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/fd-calculator): Fixed deposit maturity interest calculator with quarterly compounding.

## Student Tools

- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/percentage-calculator): Compute exam marks percentages, aggregate subject scores, and target grade gaps.
- [CGPA Calculator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/cgpa-calculator): Convert university CGPA/SGPA to percentage using standard educational multipliers.
- [Age Calculator](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/age-calculator): Determine exact chronological age in years, months, and days for job and admission cutoffs.
- [Study Timer](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/study-timer): Distraction-free Pomodoro (25/5) and custom interval study timer.
- [Word Counter](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/word-counter): Character, word, sentence, and paragraph counter with estimated reading time.

## Categories

- [Finance Tools](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/finance): Calculators for loans, investments, taxes, and salary planning.
- [Student Tools](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/student): Educational tools for grades, timers, age, and essay analysis.
- [Document Tools](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/documents): File conversion, image processing, and PDF compression.
- [Everyday Tools](https://www.smartlytools.cyou/tools/everyday): Day-to-day productivity tools, converters, and QR generators.
